Health Sciences

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

VU Health Sciences studies population health and wellbeing through biological, behavioral, social, environmental and policy perspectives. Students investigate health inequalities, prevention and the organisation of healthcare, with research and community-based learning.

A complete comparison is awaiting verified curriculum information for Fall 2026 entrants. The confirmed subset below contains 120 EC across the first two years and at least 30 EC of open study. The remaining third-year course credits and research requirements are unresolved, so no UCR alternative is presented. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.

Academic year: 2026–2027

Verified subset: 150 of 180 EC. Each second-year choice row represents one 6 EC selection from its listed options. The new-cohort allocation for Methodologie 5, professional development, placement and thesis needs confirmation. The older-cohort third-year statistics and placement table does not establish that allocation. Language testing gates the prevention-course grade; progression and open-study approval rules apply.
